# Background on *Delftia* {.unnumbered}

*Delftia* are Gram-negative, aerobic, rod-shaped bacteria first isolated from soil. *D. acidovorans* was reclassified from *Comamonas* into its own genus in 1999 [@wen1999], and *D. tsuruhatensis* was described from activated sludge in Japan in 2003 [@shigematsu2003]. Species have properties relevant to gold precipitation, metal biosorption, and, in strain TC1, suppression of parasite development in insect vectors.

- **Section 1:** TC1 was isolated from *Anopheles stephensi* mosquitoes unable to sustain *Plasmodium falciparum*, and secretes the small molecule harmane that inhibits parasite development [@huang2023].
- **Section 2:** TC1 colonizes the midgut of *Phlebotomus duboscqi* sand flies and affects the development of *Leishmania major* [@cecilio2025].

See the original *The Delftia Book* [@sharma2026] for the full text. Full citations are in the [References](references.qmd).
